title: Regional Pathogen Reduction Study — data management workplan

sources.title: GWMA Addendum No. 1 and revised attachments

decisions.title: Confirm wet and dry beach monitoring scope
decisions.note: RFQ section 2 and Attachment C describe the beach wet/dry scope differently. Resolve the collection design in the approved Health Risk Assessment Work Plan.

decisions.title: Select indicator bacteria, pathogen and source-tracking constituents
decisions.note: Retain analyte, method, matrix and sample fraction separately. Final scientific design determines constituents and risk-relevant detection limits.

decisions.title: Approve sample/event identifiers and time conventions
decisions.note: Bind station, sampling event, collection timezone, wet/dry classification and sample/replicate identity. Preserve original strings and document corrections.

decisions.title: Approve nondetect, DNQ, qualifier and sentinel interpretation
decisions.note: CEDEN 2.0 and legacy exports have different source contracts. Preserve original result text, MDL, MRL/RL, qualifier and QA codes; select explicit analytical contracts.

decisions.title: Define microbiology and molecular QC review
decisions.note: Use method-specific culture duplicate confidence intervals or Rlog and separate field duplicate assessment. Record PCR-specific quality controls.

decisions.title: Select and version the risk model inputs and outputs
decisions.note: Define hazards, exposure, dose-response assumptions, uncertainty and sensitivity with the scientific team. The intake software preserves measured inputs and explicit contracts.

decisions.title: Approve control-cost and source-strength scenario definitions
decisions.note: Keep costs per retained volume, linear foot and managed area distinct. Record control, source-strength assumptions, model version and uncertainty.

decisions.title: Record accepted workplans and implementation authorization
decisions.note: Initial notice to proceed covers technical stakeholder participation and the Health Risk Assessment and Risk Management Work Plans. Preserve Sponsor review/acceptance and GWMA implementation decision.
